modules.title: 浏览器怎样使用这枚小图标

items.title: 它标识浏览器里的站点
items.text: 标签页、书签和历史记录可以显示同一枚 Favicon，让用户在浏览器界面中快速认出网站。它不负责解释页面里的操作。

items.title: 必须看真实浏览器结果
items.text: 发布后先确认 HTML 关联的资源能访问，再在标签页、书签和历史记录中检查图标；旧缓存可能让刚换的资源暂时不变。

modules.title: 它不等于 Logo 或界面图标
modules.text: {c:favicon} 是浏览器特定位置使用的小图标；{c:logo} 是页面中的品牌标志；{c:icon} 表达搜索、关闭等功能。三者可以共享视觉母体，但替换其中一个不会自动改变另外两个。

lessonPractice.title: 换了页头 Logo 后，浏览器标签页仍显示旧图标，应该先检查什么？

options.label: 检查 Favicon 资源和 rel=icon 配置，再清楚说明可能存在的缓存
options.feedback: 对。页头 Logo 和浏览器 Favicon 是两条使用路径，应检查图标资源、关联配置和浏览器缓存。

options.label: 继续调整 Header 里的 Logo，直到标签页自动变化
options.feedback: Header 只负责页面中的品牌入口，不会自动替换浏览器标签页图标。

options.label: 把工具栏里的功能图标改成新品牌图形
options.feedback: 界面功能图标服务于操作含义，与浏览器识别站点的 Favicon 不是同一个对象。

en.title: After the header Logo changes, the browser tab still shows the old icon. What should you check first?

options.label: Check the Favicon asset and rel=icon configuration, then account for possible caching
options.feedback: Correct. The header Logo and browser Favicon are separate paths, so inspect the asset, relation, and browser cache.

options.label: Keep adjusting the Header Logo until the tab changes by itself
options.feedback: The Header owns the brand entry in the page; it does not automatically replace the browser tab icon.

options.label: Replace a toolbar action icon with the new brand shape
options.feedback: A UI action icon communicates an operation and is separate from the Favicon that identifies the site in the browser.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 请替换网站 Favicon，保留页头 Logo 和工具栏功能图标不变。检查 rel=icon 指向的资源，部署后分别验证浏览器标签页、书签和历史记录；如果仍显示旧图标，请说明缓存证据和下一步验证方式。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: Replace the site's Favicon while leaving the header Logo and toolbar action icons unchanged. Check the asset referenced by rel=icon, then verify the browser tab, bookmark, and history after deployment. If the old icon remains, report the caching evidence and the next verification step.

learning.assumes: You have seen a small site icon in a browser tab, bookmark, or history list.
learning.outcome: You can distinguish a Favicon from a header Logo and a UI action icon, then verify the Favicon in browser surfaces.

modules.title: How the browser uses this small icon

items.title: It identifies a site in the browser
items.text: Tabs, bookmarks, and history can show the same Favicon so people can recognize a website quickly. It does not explain an action inside the page.

items.title: Verify the real browser result
items.text: After publishing, confirm that the linked asset is reachable and inspect it in tabs, bookmarks, and history; an old cache may keep the previous asset visible for a while.

modules.title: It is not a Logo or UI icon
modules.text: {c:favicon} is used in browser surfaces; a {c:logo} is a brand mark in page content; an {c:icon} communicates a search, close, or other function. They may share a visual source, but changing one does not automatically change the others.

distinctions.label: Logo
distinctions.text: {c:favicon} appears in browser tabs, bookmarks, and history; a {c:logo} usually appears in page content to identify a brand.

distinctions.label: UI icon
distinctions.text: {c:favicon} identifies the site; an {c:icon} communicates a function, object, or status inside the page.
